method: Three plate-sorted registrations per selected exact group; two distinct common passenger models per priority brand and twenty distinct van models. Purposive sample; no fleet power/fuel share extrapolation.
join: Exact kenteken join for this bounded sample only; every returned fuel row retained, including hybrid/electric rows.

registrationVerification.method: Bounded exact registration join: present in current RDW register, export_indicator=Nee, nonempty datum_tenaamstelling and tenaamstellen_mogelijk=Ja. This verifies the published registration state, not insurance, road use or mechanical condition.
